chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Trimming the nails on the day of Friday ensures protection from leprosy, vitiligo, and blindness; and if you do not need to trim them, then file them.
ai.seo_question: What are the benefits of trimming nails on Friday according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links the Friday grooming ritual of clipping nails to specific physical protections against leprosy, vitiligo, and blindness, reflecting the Shia emphasis on integrating bodily purity with spiritual devotion. The hadith further offers a practical nuance, suggesting that even filing the nails provides benefit for those who do not require full clipping, thereby emphasizing consistent maintenance of the Sunnah of cleanliness.
